headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents a Past
lede: Claude-Mem turns scattered agent activity into searchable project memory. A local worker captures sessions, summarizes observations, and retrieves context through SQLite and Chroma without forcing developers to repeat yesterday’s decisions.

headline: OpenMausBot Builds Teams of Local Agents
lede: OpenMausBot assembles specialized agents inside a locally governed command center. Each bot gets its own model, memory, tools, and workspace, while a permission broker keeps sensitive actions behind explicit approval.

headline: Impeccable Teaches Agents Better Interface Taste
lede: Impeccable gives coding agents a sharper visual vocabulary for building the web. Its commands and deterministic detectors challenge weak contrast, generic typography, predictable layouts, and the familiar fingerprints of machine-made design.

headline: OpenBot Puts AI Coworkers Behind Glass
lede: OpenBot gives autonomous agents dedicated workspaces without handing the keys to a hosted platform. Gateways inspect computer, file, MCP, and interface actions, creating an auditable boundary between automation and the systems it touches.

headline: A Charting Engine Preserves Zi Wei Dou Shu
lede: This TypeScript engine translates the traditional Zi Wei Dou Shu system into reproducible calculations and structured data. Solar-time corrections, calendar conversion, star transformations, and large interpretation datasets make a culturally specific practice inspectable by researchers and builders.

headline: Expo Skills Map the Mobile Build
lede: Expo’s skill collection lays out a practical route through React Native development, from project structure and native modules to releases, upgrades, and crash diagnosis. Agents load focused SKILL.md instructions as the work changes, keeping implementation guidance close to the build.

headline: Macro Connects the Workday’s Loose Threads
lede: Macro consolidates email, messaging, documents, tasks, CRM, code, and agents into one searchable workspace. Its linked graph carries context across those surfaces, while CRDTs and Durable Objects keep collaborative work synchronized and recoverable.

headline: Engineering Discipline Finds an Agent Audience
lede: Matt Pocock’s skills package puts TDD, domain modeling, and requirement alignment directly into the coding-agent loop. Its modular commands trade improvisational prompting for repeatable feedback, giving fast AI-assisted work a sturdier engineering frame.

headline: T3 Code Keeps Agents Running After Dark
lede: T3 Code turns local coding agents into a control surface reachable from phones, browsers, and desktops. A persistent local server keeps execution tied to the developer’s machine while remote interfaces coordinate projects, permissions, accounts, and source control.

headline: DeepTutor Builds a Searchable Path to Mastery
lede: DeepTutor threads personal documents, books, repositories, and media through retrieval systems that can cite their sources. Its workspaces combine tutoring, practice, assessment, and progress tracking into a connected learning pipeline rather than a single chat window.
